cyc = [1000 + 7*i for i in range(N)]

    p = [cyc[(i+j) % N] for j in range(4)]
    rib.append({'path': p, 'count': 1000000})
    rib.append({'path': p[::-1], 'count': 999999})

    rib.append(dict(rib[0]))

for rec in rib:
    p = tuple(ref.normalize(rec['path'], set()))
    agg[p] = agg.get(p,0)+rec['count']

if out.get('queries'):

# check the exact/fallback decision
spec = M.validate(doc)
vi = {tuple(l):i for i,l in enumerate(order)}
factors = [M.build_factor(tuple(l), occs_m.get(tuple(l),[]), vi) for l in order] if False else None
occs_m = M.collect_occurrences(final)
factors = [M.build_factor(tuple(l), occs_m.get(tuple(l),[]), vi) for l in order]
Z, marg = M.infer(factors, len(order))
